title: Iceland Highland Traverse
excerpt: Twelve days crossing Iceland's volcanic interior — Laugavegur, Landmannalaugar, and the Westfjords coastline.

itinerary.title: Reykjavik Arrival
itinerary.description: Evening briefing at the base. Kit inspection and cultural orientation. First taste of skyr and fermented shark.

itinerary.title: Landmannalaugar
itinerary.description: The obsidian and rhyolite highlands. Multicolored mountains — impossible greens and burnt oranges side by side.

itinerary.title: Laugavegur Day 1 — Hrafntinnusker
itinerary.description: Through fumaroles and snow fields. Steaming vents melt channels in the snowpack. Ice caves nearby.

itinerary.title: Laugavegur Day 2 — Álftavatn
itinerary.description: Descent to the alpine lake. Geese nesting. Wind from the east. The silence that only uninhabited land has.

itinerary.title: Laugavegur Day 3 — Emstrur
itinerary.description: Crossing the Bláfjallakvísl glacier river. Cold. Fast. Unforgettable. Lunar landscape of Emstrur.

itinerary.title: Þórsmörk
itinerary.description: Valley of the gods. Hidden from the rest of Iceland by three glaciers. Rare vegetation in a protected microclimate.

itinerary.title: Rest Day / Vatnajökull
itinerary.description: Drive to Europe's largest glacier. Ice caving in electric blue chambers. Glacier walking above the void.

itinerary.title: East Fjords Drive
itinerary.description: Dramatic coastal cliffs. Fishing villages. Puffin colonies at the cliff edge.

itinerary.title: Snæfellsjökull
itinerary.description: Jules Verne's gateway to the center of the earth. Crater hike on the volcanic summit.

itinerary.title: Westfjords — Dynjandi
itinerary.description: The cascade of waterfalls that few visitors reach. Seven tiers, widening as they fall.

itinerary.title: Westfjords Coast
itinerary.description: Remote peninsula hiking. Arctic fox territory. Sea cliffs above the Denmark Strait.

included: OVERLAND certified guide for all 12 days
All accommodation (mix of huts and tents)
All meals from arrival dinner through departure breakfast
